name: auralis
description: An unofficial, secure Apple Music desktop client for Linux
author: Gautham Sai <https://github.com/gautham-sai05>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist-electron && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.preload.json && mv dist-electron/preload.js dist-electron/preload.cjs && mv dist-electron/search-preload.js dist-electron/search-preload.cjs && mv dist-electron/mini-player-preload.js dist-electron/mini-player-preload.cjs
scripts.package:all: npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage deb pacman rpm flatpak
